pages.title: Borrow a Hand
pages.text: A rotting, foul-smelling arm dropped by a zombie. Strangely, it seems older than the zombie itself.
Zombies may drop Zombie Arms.$(br2)Melee-kill a Horse or Villager with one to transform it into a Zombie Horse or Zombie Villager.
Dropped by Drowned. It has simply been soaked pale.
